name: Searing
summary: Cooking the surface of food at high heat to build a browned, flavorful crust.
donenessCues: Deep brown crust; the food releases from the pan on its own.
commonMistakes: Crowding the pan, moving the food too early, starting with wet meat.

name: Caramelizing
summary: Slowly cooking food until its natural sugars brown and deepen in flavor.
donenessCues: Deep amber color, jammy texture, sweet aroma.
commonMistakes: Heat too high, rushing it, not stirring often enough near the end.
